title: Vault Based Workflow
definition: A method of working that starts with consulting the vault documents to orient oneself, ensuring up-to-date information and avoiding assumptions.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of it like checking the kitchen before you start cooking. By referring to the vault, we make sure we're working with the latest information, avoiding mistakes.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: This concept refers to the practice of beginning each session by consulting the vault documents. This ensures that the work is based on the most recent information and decisions, improving efficiency and reliability.
difficulty_levels.expert: The vault-based workflow is a systematic approach to knowledge work that not only enhances productivity but also ensures data cleanliness and privacy by design. It aligns with scientific rigor and leverages the power of automation. The vault acts as the single source of truth, providing a foundation for building robust tools and workflows. This concept also has implications for knowledge management in other fields, emphasizing the importance of consistent documentation and validation.

extra_fields.insight: Starting each session by consulting the vault documents ensures up-to-date information and avoids assumptions, improving efficiency and reliability.
